attributes.label: Busbar rating
attributes.name: rated_current
attributes.quote: AMX busbars are tin‑plated copper, rear‑isolated, mechanically braced, and rated from 800 A up to 6000 A to support high‑density power distribution.

attributes.label: Short-circuit withstand rating
attributes.name: short_time_withstand
attributes.quote: Short‑circuit withstand rating: The verified ability of the AMX switchboard, including busbars and supports, to safely withstand and carry high fault currents (up to 100 kA) without mechanical or thermal damage.

attributes.label: Type tested assembly
attributes.name: standards
attributes.quote: Type tested assembly: A switchboard that has been tested as a complete system (not just individual components) for thermal performance, dielectric integrity, and short‑circuit withstand in accordance with UL891 standard.
